snippet.title: 3 Sheep Puzzle       ²⁰²⁶
snippet.description:
About This Game
❄️ The long winter is coming!

Help Grandpa Ivan's dog, Borbo, lead some cute sheep into the barn to protect them from the harsh winter ahead. You'll solve a series of intricate puzzles in this logic game inspired by the classic Sokoban. In 3 Sheep Puzzle, the visual simplicity hides challenges that will test your planning skills and spatial awareness. Every move counts. As the sheepdog of this small flock, you must move the sheep from a distance and guide them to the barn.

🐾 Key Features:

Classic Mechanics: Puzzles where you move sheep in one direction or another, as long as Borbo, the dog, is in the same row or column and moves within that row or column.

Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean and clear 2D graphics so you can focus 100% on solving the board.

🏆 Challenge and Competition

For shepherds striving for perfection, the game offers additional challenges:

Marathon Mode: Complete the last 10 levels of the game in one go. Compete in the global rankings where efficiency is key: the first criterion is the fewest moves, and the second is the total time.

Steam Achievements: Prove your mastery by unlocking exclusive achievements. Can you find them all and become the ultimate shepherd?

Global Leaderboards: Compare your results with players from around the world and fight for the number one spot on the leaderboard.

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI tools were used to assist in creating the game's graphical assets (characters and environments), as well as in code development and mechanics optimization. The final output has been manually supervised and refined to ensure a consistent and functional gameplay experience.

System Requirements
MINIMUM:
OS: Windows 10 o Windows 11
PROCESSOR: Dual Core 2.0 GHz o similar
MEMORY: 2 GB RAM
DIRECTX: Version 10
NETWORK: Broadband Internet connection
STORAGE: 200 MB available space
ADDITIONAL NOTES: 3 Sheep Puzzle is optimized to run on laptops and basic office computers. An internet connection is required for global ranking features, but the game is fully playable offline.
